name: io.github.coroniumio/coronium-proxy-mcp
title: Coronium mobile proxies
description: Buy and manage Coronium 4G/5G mobile proxies: plans, stock, quotes, test, rotate and replace.

environmentVariables.name: CORONIUM_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Dashboard API token from dashboard.coronium.io, Account, API Access. Optional: without it, the buyer and full profiles offer coronium_create_account, so an agent can open its own account.

environmentVariables.name: CORONIUM_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Which tools to expose: buyer, directory, full (default) or read-only.

environmentVariables.name: CORONIUM_ENABLE_SPENDING
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to add the money tools to the buyer and full profiles: buy and renew (account credit, BTC or a saved card) and crypto to credit; full also adds pool purchases and cancel with refund. Off unless set.
